correctness.rationale: Explicit normal form for all word maps of S3 follows from the semidirect multiplication law. The Fox-type coefficient constraint is proved by induction; every coefficient array satisfying it is realized by even-parity squares/commutators and character projectors. Conditional rotation counts produce the exact arity spectrum. One-variable powers are handled separately. The package checker verifies 972 two-variable word maps, 124 local ranks, 828 direct evaluations; arbitrary-arity validity is proved symbolically.
